subject: mathematics
content: Let a differentiable function $f$ satisfy the equation $\int_0^{36} f\left(\frac{t x}{36}\right) d t=4 \alpha f(x)$. If $y=f(x)$ is a standard parabola passing through the points $(2,1)$ and $(-4, \beta)$, then $\beta^\alpha$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$ .
